events.title: NVIDIA publishes an OpenShell architecture and previews Sentry
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 发布 OpenShell 架构并预告 Sentry
events.summary: NVIDIA published a reference architecture around the Apache-2.0 OpenShell agent runtime. OpenShell separates gateway, supervisor, sandbox and policy-prover controls from the agent workload. NVIDIA also previewed Sentry, a BlueField-4 hardware-isolated layer for traffic inspection, memory introspection and containment; Sentry is planned for early 2027, while OpenShell code is available now.

events.title: Ai2 releases FairStress to test hidden asymmetry in LLM decisions
events.title_zh: Ai2 发布 FairStress 测试 LLM 决策中的隐性不对称
events.summary: Ai2 released FairStress, an open benchmark that tests whether matched persuasive prefixes change LLM decisions differently across demographic groups. It expands 300 scenarios across 29 high-stakes domains into more than 13 million cases, with a 50K-item core subset, public CC-BY-4.0 data and code. The benchmark uses an equality-centered definition of fairness and does not cover every equity framework.
events.summary_en: Ai2 released FairStress, an open benchmark that tests whether matched persuasive prefixes change LLM decisions differently across demographic groups. It expands 300 scenarios across 29 high-stakes domains into more than 13 million cases, with a 50K-item core subset, public CC-BY-4.0 data and code. The benchmark uses an equality-centered definition of fairness and does not cover every equity framework.
events.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 FairStress，测试成对的说服性前缀是否会因人口群体不同而让 LLM 以不同幅度改变决定。它把 29 个高风险领域的 300 个场景扩展为 1300 多万个测试，并提供 5 万条核心子集、CC-BY-4.0 数据与公开代码。该 benchmark 采用以平等为中心的公平定义，不能覆盖所有公平观。
events.why_it_matters: For teams placing models in hiring, lending, healthcare or education workflows, final-answer parity can hide unstable decision criteria. Use FairStress as a predeployment stress test, while keeping domain policy and human review separate.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams placing models in hiring, lending, healthcare or education workflows, final-answer parity can hide unstable decision criteria. Use FairStress as a predeployment stress test, while keeping domain policy and human review separate.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对把模型用于招聘、信贷、医疗或教育流程的团队，只看最终答案一致可能掩盖不稳定的判断标准。FairStress 适合作为上线前压力测试，但不能替代领域政策与人工复核。

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用 50K 核心集比较两个候选模型的正确率与成对切换差异。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, use the 50K core split to compare accuracy and paired switching gaps for two candidate models.

evidence.claim_zh: Ai2 发布 FairStress，测试成对的说服性前缀是否会因人口群体不同而让 LLM 以不同幅度改变决定。它把 29 个高风险领域的 300 个场景扩展为 1300 多万个测试，并提供 5 万条核心子集、CC-BY-4.0 数据与公开代码。该 benchmark 采用以平等为中心的公平定义，不能覆盖所有公平观。
evidence.claim_en: Ai2 released FairStress, an open benchmark that tests whether matched persuasive prefixes change LLM decisions differently across demographic groups. It expands 300 scenarios across 29 high-stakes domains into more than 13 million cases, with a 50K-item core subset, public CC-BY-4.0 data and code. The benchmark uses an equality-centered definition of fairness and does not cover every equity framework.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; performance claims remain publisher-reported where noted

changes.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 FairStress 测试 LLM 决策中的隐性不对称
changes.summary_en: Ai2 releases FairStress to test hidden asymmetry in LLM decisions
